cmp:1rm4ewm1v4bask.why: The tighter card inside a wider one the owner questioned: Drop 28:15, the story of Musa, and keep the three ayat sharing the long run «ولا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان إنه لكم عدو مبين» together with the five-ayah card that shows what comes before «الشيطان ... إنه لكم عدو مبين» (follow his steps, worship him, let him turn you away).

cmp:0k12agv1uf8der.why: The tighter card inside a wider one the owner questioned: Fifteen places are too many for one card; the useful split is «بل أكثرهم» against «ولاكن أكثرهم», plus the close pairs after «وعد الله حق» and «الحمد لله».

tree:0x5b27e1n6a69i.why: The six ayat share only the closing «في السماوات والأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم»; the good card is the openers 57:1, 59:1 and 61:1 («سبح لله ما في السماوات (وما في) الأرض»), which the books already compare, while 30:27 and 45:37 do not belong.

tree:0w847rn10obxh1.why: Ten ayat with only «من ولي ولا» in common; the good card is 2:107, 9:116, 29:22 and 42:31 «وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير» (with the 2:120 and 13:37 pair «ما لك من الله من ولي ولا نصير / واق» as a second card), while 9:74, 18:26, 32:4 and 42:8 end differently.

tree:0izl9on127msfx.why: Only the closing «إن الله سميع عليم», a stock formula, after six unrelated rulings.
